description: A3 task 3 (F1): Round 7’s timed flow saves for real and History reads it back (REQ-026, REQ-030, REQ-031; JOURNEY-031 and JOURNEY-026, completion owner). check-01 proves the wiring on the real components over the real BlockCompletionProvider: the product presentation’s timedWorkflows.saveResult is the shell’s timed save (saveTimedLog → saveTimedResult), each timed format saves its own contract with block, round and movement identity, a refused write keeps the draft and the dialog and the retry converges, the saved row is read back, the forward action still saves an unsaved log, the attempt survives a remount as the shipped renderers’ did; History detail draws the categorical effort face apart from RPE, each movement’s recorded actual and For Time’s Incomplete; History keeps Round 7’s rows and the TASK-026 filter. The route-level journeys are e2e/refinement/task-047.spec.ts (JOURNEY-031, rewritten for Round 7) and e2e/refinement/task-026.spec.ts (JOURNEY-026, rewritten rows), run under their own manifests. parity is the look check: each real route this task wires beside its accepted gallery state (bec4454: emom, amrap, for_time, ladder, screens) with matched data at 320 and 390 px; every visible difference must be labelled with the criterion that intends it, and each case writes its receipt to evidence/refinement/task-103/parity/. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-103 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/session-detail-timed-actuals.test.tsx src/state/block-completion-provider.test.tsx src/test/block-completion-ownership.test.ts src/state/session-detail.test.ts src/app/SessionDetail.test.tsx src/app/History.test.tsx src/ui/timed-flow-save.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
